disability.disabilities.color_blind.desc: You see in black and white
disability.disabilities.diabetes.desc: The more sugar in a food, the more damage it deals when eaten
disability.disabilities.schizophrenia.de: You see and hear things that aren't real
disability.disabilities.seizures.desc: Damage, low hunger, or negative status effects have a chance to cause seizures
disability.disabilities.cancer.desc: Your maximum health slowly wastes away
disability.disabilities.ocd.desc: You have random compulsions that you must obey
disability.disabilities.amputated_leg.de: You must jump to move around
disability.disabilities.dyslexia.desc: You cannot read almost all text
disability.disabilities.short.desc: You are half a block shorter, and have shortened reach
disability.disabilities.dementia.desc: Items randomly move and hide until you click them
disability.disabilities.asthma.desc: Sprinting for too long causes you to suffocate
disability.disabilities.pollen_allergy.d: Getting near anything with pollen gives you poison
disability.disabilities.arthritis.desc: Mining and attack time is increased
disability.disabilities.brittle_bones.de: You take twice as much fall damage
disability.disabilities.tourettes.desc: Your camera randomly jerks and you randomly say things in chat
disability.disabilities.vertigo.desc: The world randomly starts to tilt and spin
disability.disabilities.lactose_intolera: Consuming anything with milk kills you instantly
death.attack.disabilities.diabetes.playe: %1$s ate too much sugar whilst fighting %2$s
message.disabilities.swapped_many: You recovered from %s disabilities, but developed %s.
multiplayer.disabilities.missing_mod:
This server runs the Disabilities mod.
You need it installed to join.
hud.disabilities.title: Disabilities
commands.disabilities.give.all: Gave every disability to %s. Good luck.
commands.disabilities.next.none: Nothing to give — they already have everything.
commands.disabilities.reset: Run reset for the whole server — everyone is clean and the countdown restarted.
commands.disabilities.timer.status: Timer is %s: every %s, mode %s, next in %s.
commands.disabilities.timer.on: Timer enabled — the countdown continues where it left off.
commands.disabilities.timer.off: Timer disabled — nothing will be handed out automatically. Use /disability give or next.
commands.disabilities.timer.set: Disability timer set to %s for everyone — countdown restarted.
commands.disabilities.timer.mode.replace: Timer mode set to replace: when the timer runs out, every disability is cured and one new one is rolled.
commands.disabilities.timer.mode.stack: Timer mode set to stack: when the timer runs out, a new disability is added on top of the others.
